title: prompt-cache-spread (history rewrites near the tail)
inspiration: DeepInfer: SWA bounded replay (re-decode the useful suffix, not everything). Strata: --prompt-cache-spread keeps checkpoints geometrically spaced from the end.
conditions: Targets the agent pattern of rewriting history a few thousand tokens before the tail - the exact use case cited by the flag's documentation.
acceptance: on 24h agent traces: reused/prompt_total +5 points; no regression on linear chats (bench_ab suite).
verdict: NOT YET TESTED - needs a cutover window.
